lines.text: On the other side is a clearing full of lantern moths, drifting like slow orange sparks. Sitting on a mushroom, holding a very large acorn, is a bramble sprite about the size of a teapot.
"Nobody comes through the hedge. Hello. I have an acorn."
"and somebody took the Hollow Crown out of the old shrine, and now the wood hums all night and nobody can sleep."
Pib hands you half a map, drawn in berry juice, and gives you the acorn too, because Pib is generous.
Behind the door, somebody very small says:
"I only borrowed it. I was going to put it back."
